# Authored mock fixtures

These files are **hand-authored stand-ins for model output**, derived from the
handwritten interpretations of examples 1, 2 and 4. They exist to test plumbing
(prompting, schema checks, caching, freezing, `--auto` verification) offline.
They are not LLM results and say nothing about how a real model would formalise
the request. The adversarial fixture is the permissive reading, not a generated
adversarial one.
